title: VentureAtlasVentureBet
description: A bounded commitment to learn or create value from a canonical idea. One idea can generate multiple bets with radically different cost, time, reversibility, and information value.

ideaId.description: References canonical idea — read-only, never mutated.

action.description: Strategic action type for this bet.

strategicRole.description: Strategic function of this bet in the portfolio. A bet with a low standalone score can be a superb stepping-stone.

cost.description: Separate cost tiers — cheap MVP does not imply cheap company.

minimumToLearn.description: Minimum cost needed to answer the most important question — not the MVP cost.

weeksToFirstSignal.description: Time to reduce key uncertainty — often more important than time-to-MVP.

attentionLoad.description: Cognitive load distinct from hours. Three unrelated 10-hour projects impose greater burden than one 30-hour project.

informationValue.description: How valuable is the uncertainty this bet resolves? Bounded EVSI reasoning — use bands, not fake precision.

crossPortfolioReach.description: How many other portfolio bets does this information update?

optionValue.description: This bet may be attractive because it creates rights to make better future commitments.

optionsUnlocked.description: Descriptions of future options this bet creates.

expiryRisk.description: What might expire if we wait?

waitValue.description: Is there value in waiting? Specify conditions.

assetsCreated.description: Strategic assets this bet is expected to create. Asset IDs link to strategic-assets.json.

capabilityRequirements.description: Required capability levels. Gap = requirement minus available.

capabilityLearned.description: A bet can be attractive because it teaches a strategically important capability that unlocks future opportunities.

riskExposures.description: Shared risk factors this bet is exposed to. Used for portfolio concentration analysis.

killCriteria.description: Pre-defined kill criteria. Required before commitments above MICRO_PROTOTYPE level.

revivalCriteria.description: What would need to change to make this bet attractive again after killing?

preMortem.description: Imagine it is 12 months later and this bet failed. Why? Pre-committed failure causes.

preParade.description: Imagine it unexpectedly succeeded. What probably went right? Reveals necessary success conditions.

bottleneckAssumption.description: The one uncertain assumption that dominates feasibility. Out of 15 uncertainties, find the bottleneck.

resolution.description: How this bet resolved — preserved for honest retrospective.

failureQuality.description: A failed bet can be high quality if it was cheap, resolved important uncertainty, and created reusable learning.
